title: The daemon binds its host contract in seconds and never writes into worktrees
goal: The daemon host contract came up only after a ~30-minute boot on Windows (refused loopback connects cost ~2 s; leaf clients redialled every call; the daemon bound last after the whole CLI composition), so susi start reported failure; and the daemon wrote intent-gap task files into whatever repo its cwd was. Fix both, with supervision, bus sweeping and test-isolation fixes found on the way.
